assumptions: ciede2000 = classical::score(Kind::Ciede2000) -> ciede2000_mean (classical.rs:126-133, 335-388). Mean of per-pixel dE00, f64.

Ingress per pixel (both images, joint loop): 6 LUT gathers (256-entry f64 sRGB->linear table, classical.rs:345), 2x sRGB->XYZ 3x3 (9 mul + 6 add each), 2x xyz_to_lab: 3 div (x/XN etc) + 3 f_lab (cmp + cbrt -> pow; linear-branch is rare) + L/a/b (mul3+add3) each (classical.rs:399-422).

CIEDE2000 (classical.rs:424-520) counted on the common branches: c1/c2 (2mul+1add+sqrt each), g (powi7=pow + div + sqrt + ~4 ops), a'p (2mul+2add), c'p (4mul+2add+2sqrt), h' atan2 x2 + 2 wrap cmp/add, dl/dc/dh (3 sub + c1p*c2p cmp + 2 branch cmps + wrap add), dh = 2*sqrt(c1p*c2p)*sin(dh/2) (mul3+sqrt+trig), bars (3 add-mul), h_bar branch (2 cmp + add + mul), T (4 cos + 4 mul + 5 add), SL/SC/SH (mul4+add3+div1+sqrt), RT (exp + powi7x2->pow2 + div + sqrt + mul + sin + trig+mul), terms (3 div + 3 powi2->pow/mul + mul2 + add3 + sqrt).
powi(7) counted as pow 1; cbrt as pow 1; atan2/sin/cos as trig.
Score: sum_de / n (1 div + 1 add/elem fold).
